arxiv-2202-03791.title: Kleene Theorem for Higher-Dimensional Automata
arxiv-2202-03791.creator: Uli Fahrenberg, Christian Johansen, Georg Struth, Krzysztof Ziemiański
arxiv-2202-03791.description: Abstract . We prove a Kleene theorem for higher-dimensional automata. It states that the languages they recognise are precisely the rational subsumption-closed sets of finite interval pomsets. The rational operations on these languages include a gluing composition, for which we equip pomsets with interfaces.

arxiv-2205-06045.title: On generalization of Lipschitz groups and spin groups Publication type: Special issue paper Thanks: The publication was prepared within the framework of the Academic Fund Program at the HSE University in 2022 (grant 22-00-001).
arxiv-2205-06045.creator: Ekaterina Filimoshina, Dmitry Shirokov*
arxiv-2205-06045.description: Abstract This paper presents some new Lie groups preserving fixed subspaces of geometric algebras (or Clifford algebras) under the twisted adjoint representation. We consider the cases of subspaces of fixed grades and subspaces determined by the grade involution and the reversion. Some of the considered Lie groups can be interpreted as generalizations of Lipschitz groups and spin groups.

arxiv-2207-02559.title: Surface Plasmon-Driven Electron and Proton Acceleration without Grating Coupling
arxiv-2207-02559.creator: J. Sarma, A. McIlvenny, N. Das, M. Borghesi, A. Macchi
arxiv-2207-02559.description: Abstract Surface plasmon (SP) excitation in intense laser interaction with solid target can be exploited for enhancing secondary emissions, in particular efficient acceleration of high charge electron bunches. Previous studies have mostly used grating coupling to allow SP excitation, which requires stringent laser contrast conditions to preserve the structural integrity of the target.

arxiv-2212-01822.title: Flow by Gauss curvature to the L p L_{p} -Gaussian Minkowski problem Thanks: This paper is a revised version of an earlier paper submitted on August 21, 2021. In this new version we added Theorem 1.4 for the case − n − 1 < p ≤ 0 -n-1<p\leq 0 and made some revisions.
arxiv-2212-01822.creator: Weimin Sheng, Ke Xue
arxiv-2212-01822.description: Abstract . In this paper we study the L p L_{p} -Gaussian Minkowski problem, which arises in the L p L_{p} -Brunn-Minkowski theory in Gaussian probability space. We use Aleksandrov’s variational method with Lagrange multipliers to prove the existence of the logarithmic Gauss Minkowski problem.

arxiv-2305-14388.title: Mathematical modelling of cancer invasion: Phenotypic transitioning provides insight into multifocal foci formation
arxiv-2305-14388.creator: Zuzanna Szymańska, Mirosław Lachowicz, Nikolaos Sfakianakis, Mark Chaplain
arxiv-2305-14388.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zuzanna Szymańska, Mirosław Lachowicz, Nikolaos Sfakianakis, Mark Chaplain. The transition from the epithelial to mesenchymal phenotype and its reverse (from mesenchymal to epithelial) are crucial processes necessary for the progression and spread of cancer. In this paper, we investigate how phenotypic switching at the cancer cell level impacts on behaviour at the tissue level, specifically on the emergence of isolated foci of the invading solid tumour mass leading to a multifocal tumour.

arxiv-2307-10319.title: Frequency-dependent electron power absorption mode transitions in capacitively coupled argon-oxygen plasmas
arxiv-2307-10319.creator: A. Derzsi, M. Vass, R. Masheyeva, B. Horváth, Z. Donkó, P. Hartmann
arxiv-2307-10319.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by A. Derzsi, M. Vass, R. Masheyeva, B. Horváth, Z. Donkó, P. Hartmann. Phase Resolved Optical Emission Spectroscopy (PROES) measurements combined with 1d3v Particle-in-Cell/Monte Carlo Collision (PIC/MCC) simulations are performed to investigate the excitation dynamics in low-pressure capacitively coupled plasmas (CCPs) in argon-oxygen mixtures.

arxiv-2308-01372.title: Sequential Small Coronal Mass Ejections Observed In situ and in White-Light Images by Parker Solar Probe
arxiv-2308-01372.creator: Brian E. Wood, Phillip Hess, Yu Chen, Qiang Hu
arxiv-2308-01372.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Brian E. Wood, Phillip Hess, Yu Chen, Qiang Hu. We reconstruct the morphology and kinematics of a series of small transients that erupt from the Sun on 2021 April 24 using observations primarily from Parker Solar Probe (PSP). These sequential small coronal mass ejections (CMEs) may be the product of continuous reconnection at a current sheet, a macroscopic example of the more microscopic reconnection activity that has been proposed to accelerate the solar wind more generally.

arxiv-2310-18975.title: Blacksmith: Fast Adversarial Training of Vision Transformers via a Mixture of Single-step and Multi-step Methods
arxiv-2310-18975.creator: Mahdi Salmani, Alireza Dehghanpour Farashah, Mohammad Azizmalayeri, Mahdi Amiri, Navid Eslami, Mohammad Taghi Manzuri, Mohammad Hossein Rohban
arxiv-2310-18975.description: Abstract Despite the remarkable success achieved by deep learning algorithms in various domains, such as computer vision, they remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Adversarial Training (AT) stands out as one of the most effective solutions to address this issue; however, single-step AT can lead to Catastrophic Overfitting (CO).

arxiv-2408-11297.title: Making Large Vision Language Models to be Good Few-shot Learners
arxiv-2408-11297.creator: Fan Liu, Wenwen Cai, Jian Huo, Chuanyi Zhang, Delong Chen, Jun Zhou
arxiv-2408-11297.description: Abstract Few-shot classification (FSC) is a fundamental yet challenging task in computer vision that involves recognizing novel classes from limited data. While previous methods have focused on enhancing visual features or incorporating additional modalities, Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) offer a promising alternative due to their rich knowledge and strong visual perception.

arxiv-2412-11278.title: VAR models with an index structure: A survey with new results
arxiv-2412-11278.creator: Gianluca Cubadda
arxiv-2412-11278.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Gianluca Cubadda. The main aim of this paper is to review recent advances in the multivariate autoregressive index model [MAI], originally proposed by Reinsel, (1983) , and their applications to economic and financial time series. MAI has recently gained momentum because it can be seen as a link between two popular but distinct multivariate time series approaches: vector autoregressive modeling [VAR] and the dynamic factor model [DFM].

arxiv-2510-08895.title: Travel Bans vs. Social Distancing: A Mathematical Analysis
arxiv-2510-08895.creator: Christian Borgs, Karissa Huang, Geng Zhao
arxiv-2510-08895.description: Abstract As the world grows increasingly connected, infectious disease transmission and outbreaks become a pressing global concern for public health officials and policymakers. While policy interventions to contain and prevent the spread of disease have been proposed and implemented, there has been little rigorous quantitative analysis of the effectiveness of such interventions.

arxiv-2511-21925.title: OpenTwinMap: An Open-Source Digital Twin Generator for Urban Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2511-21925.creator: Alex Richardson, Jonathan Sprinkle
arxiv-2511-21925.description: Abstract Digital twins of urban environments play a critical role in advancing autonomous vehicle (AV) research by enabling simulation, validation, and integration with emerging generative world models. While existing tools have demonstrated value, many publicly available solutions are tightly coupled to specific simulators, difficult to extend, or introduce significant technical overhead.

arxiv-2512-07193.title: Towards Benchmarking Design Pattern Detection Under Obfuscation: Reproducing and Evaluating Attention-Based Detection Method
arxiv-2512-07193.creator: Manthan Shenoy, Andreas Rausch
arxiv-2512-07193.description: Abstract This paper investigates the semantic robustness of attention- based classifiers for design pattern detection, particularly focusing on their reliance on structural and behavioral semantics. We reproduce the DPD Att , an attention-based design pattern detection approach using learning based classifiers–and evaluate its performance under obfuscation.

arxiv-2606-31800.title: Evo-PI: Aligning Medical Reasoning via Evolving Principle-Guided Supervision
arxiv-2606-31800.creator: Xianda Zheng, Huan Gao, Meng-Fen Chiang, Michael Witbrock, Kaiqi Zhao, Shangyang Li

pmc-10527215.title: Inhibition of EphA3 Expression in Tumour Stromal Cells Suppresses Tumour Growth and Progression
pmc-10527215.creator: Mary E Vail, Rae H Farnsworth, Linda Hii, Stacey Allen, Sakshi Arora, Robin L Anderson, Ross A Dickins, Akira Orimo, Sunny Z Wu, Alexander Swarbrick, Andrew M Scott, Peter W Janes, Sanjay Gupta, Álvaro González
pmc-10527215.description: Simple SummaryWe have identified the cell guidance receptor EphA3 on distinct stromal/fibroblast-like cell types in the tumour microenvironment (TME) that promote growth and angiogenesis, both in human cancers and in mouse tumour models. To investigate its role in the TME, we developed novel transgenic mice with inducible shRNA-mediated knockdown of EphA3 expression.

pmc-10657194.title: An Integrative Approach to Study the Inhibition of Providencia vermicola FabD Using C2-Quaternary Indolinones
pmc-10657194.creator: Ankita Khataniar, Abhichandan Das, Manash J Baruah, Kusum K Bania, Sanchaita Rajkhowa, Sami A Al-Hussain, Magdi E A Zaki
pmc-10657194.description: BackgroundThe present study investigates the potential bioactivity of twelve experimentally designed C-2 quaternary indolinones against Providencia spp., a bacterial group of the Enterobacteriaceae family known to cause urinary tract infections. The study aims to provide insights into the bioactive properties of the investigated compounds and their potential use in developing novel treatments against Providencia spp.

pmc-11674066.title: Within- and Between-Person Correlates of Affect and Sleep Health Among Health Science Students
pmc-11674066.creator: Yueying Wang, Jiechao Yang, Jinjin Yuan, Bilgay Izci-Balserak, Yunping Mu, Pei Chen, Bingqian Zhu, Nayantara Santhi
pmc-11674066.description: Background/Objectives: To examine the relationships between state affect and sleep health at within- and between-person levels among health science students. Methods: A correlational design was used and 54 health science students were included. The participants completed baseline and 7-day ambulatory assessments in a free-living setting.

pmc-11700321.title: Design, Synthesis and Characterization of Mn(II)Cysteine-Tyrosine Dithiocarbamate Complex for against the Cancer on MCF-7 Breast Cancer Cell Line
pmc-11700321.creator: Rugaiyah A. Arfah, Eka Pratiwi, Indah Raya, Hasnah Natsir, Paulina Taba, Herlina Rasyid, Muhammad Alfliadhi, Andi Besse Khaerunnisa, Rizal Irfandi, Sulistiani Jarre
pmc-11700321.description: Objective: Breast cancer is the most frequently diagnosed cancer and the second cause of death worldwide. The drug often used for chemotherapy is cisplatin. However, the drug cisplatin has a number of problems, including lack of selectivity, undesirable side effects, resistance, and toxicity in the body.

pmc-11862203.title: Role of Different Forms and Intensities of Physical Activity in Prevention of Dementia
pmc-11862203.creator: I. Singh, R. Chandra
pmc-11862203.description: IntroductionDementia is one of the greatest health challenges worldwide. According to the World Health Organisation (WHO) factsheet, currently more than 55 million people worldwide have dementia, with over 60% living in low- and middle-income countries. Every year, there are nearly 10 million new cases of dementia.

pmc-12649843.title: Structural and Functional Characterization of the Vacuolar-Type Na+, K+/H+ Antiporter NHX1 from Rice (Oryza sativa L.)
pmc-12649843.creator: Boning Cao, Zhiyong Xing, Jingxian Li, Ying Yuan, Xueru Lei, Hong Tang, Dan Wang, Jiali Ma, Shuangping Heng, Lin Cheng
pmc-12649843.description: Plant vacuolar-type Na+, K+/H+ antiporters (NHXs) play important roles in pH and K+ homeostasis and osmotic balance under normal physiological conditions. Under salt stress, vacuolar-type NHX enhances salt tolerance by compartmentalizing Na+ into vacuoles. However, the ion transport mechanism of vacuolar-type NHX remains poorly understood due to the absence of resolved protein crystal structures.

pmc-13111727.title: Change in diurnal temperature range on the Tibetan plateau in the last 40 years and its influencing factors
pmc-13111727.creator: Mei Chen, Xiaohang Wen, Maoshan Li, Xian Zhu, Juan Feng
pmc-13111727.description: The Tibetan Plateau (TP) is a sensitive area for climate change, with its temperature affected by global warming. However, the variation in the diurnal temperature range (DTR) remains unclear. Therefore, using observational data from 115 stations and ERA5 reanalysis data for TP and the surrounding regions from 1980 to 2022, this study explores the change in DTR and its causes.

pmc-13139435.title: Symbiotic brain-machine drawing via visual brain-computer interfaces
pmc-13139435.creator: Gao Wang, Yingying Huang, Lars Muckli, Daniele Faccio
pmc-13139435.description: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are evolving from research prototypes into clinical, assistive, and performance enhancement technologies. Despite the rapid rise and promise of implantable technologies, there is a need for better and more capable wearable and non-invasive approaches whilst also minimising hardware requirements.

pmc-13331446.title: Reconsidering the Term “Treatment Resistant Schizophrenia”
pmc-13331446.creator: Faith B Dickerson
pmc-13331446.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). degree of treatment response. Central to these efforts is the concept of “treatment resistant schizophrenia” (TRS). A 2017 expert consensus report defined TRS as referring to persons with a diagnosis of schizophrenia who have not responded adequately to at least two courses of different antipsychotic medications administered in doses equivalent to at least 600 mg of chlorpromazine per day, each for at least 6 weeks, with the patient taking at least 80% of prescribed doses over both periods.

pmc-13457410.title: Impacts of sea level rise on the world’s shorebirds
pmc-13457410.creator: Jennifer M.T. Magel, Scott Wilson, Tara G. Martin
pmc-13457410.description: Sea level rise (SLR) poses a significant threat to coastal ecosystems worldwide. Migratory shorebirds rely heavily on nearshore and intertidal ecosystems throughout the annual cycle and are currently undergoing global declines due to the loss of coastal habitat, suggesting that these species may be highly susceptible to future SLR.

pmc-13490608.title: Cooperative mechanism of neurotransmitter recognition and transport by the human vesicular polyamine transporter
pmc-13490608.creator: Yi Guo, Ge Yang, Jin Chai, John Shanklin, Bin Liu, Min Lu
pmc-13490608.description: Human vesicular polyamine transporter (hVPAT) from the SLC18 antiporter family sequesters polyamine neuromodulators into secretory vesicles in exchange for H+ in the brain, thereby sustaining learning and memory formation. As a potential therapeutic target for combatting psychostimulant use disorder, hVPAT (or SLC18B1) regulates the homeostasis of monoamine neurotransmitters via an unknown mechanism.
